lines: This is the Apex Technology ladder — how everyone, licensed or not, earns with Apex.
You earn by putting Apex's A.I. tools — like SmartViewz and Docs2Video — in the hands of businesses.
You get paid two ways. First, a commission on every sale you personally make.
Second, override income — a share that comes back to you as the team you build makes sales too.
So your income grows two ways at once: what you sell, and what your team sells.
Now, your rank. There are nine ranks, from Starter to Elite, based on your monthly volume.
Each rank has a target — your own personal volume, plus your team's group volume.
Reach Bronze at just a hundred fifty personal, three hundred group. The targets grow as you climb.
Every rank you reach unlocks deeper override levels — how far down your team you get paid.
Starter earns on one level. Elite earns on all seven — from your recruits, to their recruits, and beyond.
Your enrollment override pays on everyone you personally bring in — the biggest share, at every rank.
And the deeper levels pay more as you rank up — the higher your rank, the more of your team you earn on.
Every rank also pays a one-time bonus — more than ninety-three thousand dollars in bonuses along the way.
One simple rule to earn overrides: produce at least fifty points of personal volume a month. Sell a little, stay qualified.
That's the Technology ladder. Sell the tools, build a team, and climb — nine ranks, seven levels deep, no ceiling.
